request.subjectEmptyTokens: Subject tokens cannot contain blanks. Example: a..b is invalid.
request.subjectNoWildcard: Request subject cannot contain wildcards; use an exact subject.
request.subjectNeedDot: Request subject must contain at least one `.`.
request.payloadInvalid: Payload must be valid JSON; leave it empty to send an empty request.
request.timeoutPositiveInteger: Timeout must be a positive integer in milliseconds.
request.timedOut: Request timed out before any reply arrived.
request.noResponder: No responder is currently available for this subject.
request.unknownFailure: Request failed for an unknown reason.

watch.emptyTokens: Subject tokens cannot contain blanks. Example: a..b is invalid.
watch.noWildcard: Plain subjects cannot directly include wildcards.
watch.starToken: `*` must occupy a whole token, for example a.b.*.
watch.arrowToken: `>` must occupy a whole token, for example a.b.>.
watch.arrowLast: `>` can only appear in the last token.
watch.needDot: Subscriptions currently require at least one `.`; a bare `>` is not supported yet.
